messages:
Maya P.: Heads up — we started seeing intermittent egress failures from rdw-ded-gpu-01 in westeurope, looks like SNAT port exhaustion during the nightly model syncs.
Sam R.: Oof, which subnet and NAT setup are we using?
Maya P.: Workers are in subnet 10.10.64.0/19 on vnet-rdw-prod-west. We have a Standard NAT Gateway with a single public IP attached. Spikes during concurrent model downloads + many small outbound connections.
Kevin L.: That matches SNAT exhaustion. Single IP on a Standard NAT gives finite SNAT ports shared across pods (~64k per IP but shared), so many short-lived connections can exhaust. Options: attach more Public IPs to the NAT gateway, split load across multiple NAT gateways, or move egress through an ASG/Firewall with higher SNAT capacity.
Maya P.: Azure support suggested adding extra public IPs on the NAT gateway. We also need quota increases for Standard Public IPs in the subscription and region. Can someone confirm how many IPs we should request?
Rachel B.: Filing the public IP quota request now. @Kevin any recommendation?
Kevin L.: For initial headroom, add 3 extra public IPs (total 4). That should reduce port pressure and give room for bursts. Also propose creating a separate NAT gateway for the batch inference subnet to isolate blast radius.
Sam R.: Also, this dedicated cluster expansion will require GPU quota increases — requesting A100 80GB x8 nodes in westeurope. I'll add that to the ticket.
Maya P.: Created Azure ticket INC12345678 for public IP quota and NAT guidance. Put subscription id and vnet name in the ticket.
Rachel B.: Added a follow-up task: update route tables for peering to shared-services-vnet for PrivateLink to the model registry (10.50.0.0/16). Shared-services asked for the peering CIDR list and the routing change.
Kevin L.: For PrivateLink, we should create a Private Endpoint in our VNet and add the Private DNS zone links. Shared-services will accept peering, but we must ensure we don't advertise 10.50.0.0/16 to the internet. Keep peering as manual routes only.
Maya P.: I'll include Private Endpoint details in the ticket. Also requested NAT gateway with 4 IP configs in terraform plan.
Infra-bot: terraform apply queued by rachelb — plan locked, estimated run 2026-02-14 03:00 UTC.
Rachel B.: Working on the PR: will add azurerm_public_ip resources and attach them to azurerm_nat_gateway, plus a new nat gateway for rdw-batch-subnet. Will include cost estimate.
Sam R.: Rough cost: Standard Public IP ~ $6-8/month, NAT gateway data processing ~ $0.045/GB depending on region. Add ~ $50-70/month for extra IPs and processing for our expected traffic.
Kevin L.: Terraform snippet for the NAT gateway config: 
```
resource "azurerm_public_ip" "ip1" {
  name = "rdw-ip-1"
  location = var.location
  resource_group_name = var.rg
  allocation_method = "Static"
  sku = "Standard"
}
resource "azurerm_nat_gateway" "ngw" {
  name = "rdw-ngw-westeu"
  location = var.location
  resource_group_name = var.rg
  sku = "Standard"
  public_ip_addresses = [azurerm_public_ip.ip1.id, azurerm_public_ip.ip2.id, azurerm_public_ip.ip3.id, azurerm_public_ip.ip4.id]
}
```
Maya P.: Also adding AKS node pool change: enable accelerated networking and ensure node_pools have appropriate ephemeral port ranges.
Rachel B.: I've linked the GPU quota ticket AZQ-98765 for A100 80GB x8 — Azure responded ETA 2 business days.
Sam R.: I'll add an alert on SNAT utilization (80% threshold) and a dashboard panel for ephemeral port usage so we catch this earlier.
Maya P.: After NAT changes we'll run a canary model-sync job and monitor egress. Please add cost-center tag cc:rdw-ml-infra before apply. :thumbsup:
Rachel B.: Noted, adding tags in the PR. Will post the PR link here once ready.
Maya P.: Thanks team — will post updates from Azure ticket and the terraform plan results.
